title: Slopstrap AI slop framework
description: Mike Lacher's satirical CSS and JS framework that makes any page look hastily vibecoded by an LLM. Ships purple gradients, blinking status dots, border beams, fake testimonials, and a logo marquee out of the box. Vendored for fun and served fully offline.

faq.question: Is this a serious framework?
faq.answer: No. Slopstrap is a parody by Mike Lacher. It bundles every certified AI design tell so a page can look like an LLM built it in one shot. Use it when a demo deserves a little irony.

faq.question: How do I run these examples myself?
faq.answer: Download the zip from the assets page, unzip it, and place an example file next to the dist folder. Each example loads ./dist/slopstrap.css and ./dist/slopstrap.js with no build tools.

faq.question: Why is the preview not a React component like the others?
faq.answer: Slopstrap is plain HTML, CSS, and JS, so each preview frame runs the real framework: the vendored CSS and JS are inlined into a self-contained document built from the example. What you see in the frame is exactly what the zip produces.
